# `dashboard/views/layout.ts`

## Overview

The `layout` module provides HTML templating utilities for rendering the dashboard UI. It includes helpers for generating page structure elements such as the document `<head>`, sidebar navigation, and the full page layout wrapper. Most helpers are internal to the module, with `layout` being the primary public export.

---

## Functions

### `getInitials`

Derives initials from a full name string. Intended for use in avatar or user display components.

> **Note:** This function is not directly exported. Import via the module path.

```ts
import { getInitials } from '...';
```

#### Parameters

| Name   | Type     | Description                          |
|--------|----------|--------------------------------------|
| `name` | `string` | The full name to extract initials from. |

#### Returns

`string` — The derived initials.

---

### `sidebar`

Generates the HTML string for the sidebar navigation, personalised to the provided user session.

> **Note:** This function is not directly exported. Import via the module path.

```ts
import { sidebar } from '...';
```

#### Parameters

| Name   | Type          | Description                                      |
|--------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `user` | `SessionUser` | The current session user used to populate the sidebar. |

#### Returns

`string` — An HTML string representing the sidebar.

---

### `head`

Generates the HTML `<head>` section string for a page, including the provided title.

> **Note:** This function is not directly exported. Import via the module path.

```ts
import { head } from '...';
```

#### Parameters

| Name    | Type     | Description                          |
|---------|----------|--------------------------------------|
| `title` | `string` | The page title to include in the `<head>`. |

#### Returns

`string` — An HTML string for the document `<head>` section.

---

### `layout`

Assembles a complete HTML page by combining the `<head>`, sidebar, and main content area. This is the primary export of the module and serves as the top-level page template.

```ts
import { layout } from '...';
```

#### Parameters

| Name      | Type          | Required | Description                                           |
|-----------|---------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| `title`   | `string`      | Yes      | The page title rendered in the document `<head>`.     |
| `content` | `string`      | Yes      | The main HTML content to render in the page body.     |
| `user`    | `SessionUser` | No       | The current session user, used to render the sidebar. |

#### Returns

`string` — A complete HTML page string.

#### Example

```ts
import { layout } from 'dashboard/views/layout';

const html = layout('Dashboard', '<p>Welcome!</p>', currentUser);
res.send(html);
```
